thesis: Wheel of Fortune rewards the player who empties a hand faster, damages the opponent for drawing, or converts discarded cards into graveyard resources.

playbook.role: Sequence the Wheel after deploying cheap mana and before giving the opponent a chance to use a strong hand. In combo decks, count available mana and storm; in fair decks, consider whether refilling the opponent helps them more.

counterplay.directAnswers: Counter it when the caster has fewer cards or an engine that turns the draw into immediate action. Narset-style limits, graveyard hate, and hand-size punishment can transform the apparent symmetry into a liability.
